text: Basic residential construction cost in India ranges from 1200 to 1800 rupees per square foot for low budget housing in tier 2 and tier 3 cities.
Standard residential construction cost in India ranges from 1800 to 2500 rupees per square foot including basic flooring, plumbing, and electrical work.
Premium residential construction cost in India ranges from 2500 to 4000 rupees per square foot depending on materials like vitrified tiles and branded fittings.
Luxury construction cost in metro cities like Mumbai and Bangalore can exceed 5000 to 9000 rupees per square foot with imported marble and smart home systems.
Cement cost in India typically ranges between 370 to 430 rupees per bag depending on brand and location.
TMT steel reinforcement cost in India ranges from 58 to 68 rupees per kilogram for Fe500D grade steel used in RCC structures.
Bricks in India cost between 7 to 12 rupees per piece depending on quality and region.
River sand for construction costs between 55 to 85 rupees per cubic foot depending on availability and transportation distance.
Vitrified tiles cost between 60 to 150 rupees per square foot depending on design and brand quality.
Average labour cost in India for construction ranges from 500 to 1000 rupees per day depending on skill level and region.
Electrical wiring installation cost typically adds 120 to 250 rupees per square foot in residential construction projects.
Plumbing cost for residential buildings in India ranges from 150 to 300 rupees per square foot depending on pipe quality and fittings.
Painting and finishing work costs approximately 150 to 400 rupees per square foot depending on interior or exterior quality.
Total construction cost increases by 5 to 10 percent due to wastage, transportation, and site handling losses.
RCC structural frame construction cost forms nearly 35 to 45 percent of total building cost in residential projects.
